tasks.story: A request hook obtains a read-only header view, mutates the incoming request, and reads the headers again. The request itself reflects the mutation, but both the previously obtained view and a newly obtained view remain stale. Make the read-only API remain a live view of the underlying request while preserving its mutation guard and keeping framework-internal headers hidden from every read operation. Existing cookie snapshot behavior must not change.
tasks.contamination_prompt: where in the repository would you fix a request-hook bug where read-only header views remain stale after the underlying incoming request is mutated, while internal framework headers must stay hidden and cookie snapshot behavior must remain unchanged?
